technical.summary: Extreme overbought conditions across multiple RSI timeframes with stochastic bearish cross create pullback risk despite strong short-term trend structure; entry quality compromised by exhaustion signals and lack of confluence triggers.

fundamental.summary: EPAM shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk in 87 days—fundamentals lack bullish catalysts.

sentiment.congressional_conviction: medium — mixed signals with Republican senior member purchases offset by Democratic sale
sentiment.summary: Mixed congressional activity (Republican purchases vs Democratic sale, 77-91 days old) combined with neutral market fear/greed and unavailable news sentiment yields no actionable directional bias.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (353.1) indicates extreme market fear, CPI event in 2 days adds near-term volatility; falling DXY provides minor relief for multinational EPAM but insufficient to offset systemic risks.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong short-term trend structure (ADX trending, Supertrend bullish, Ichimoku above cloud) with price near support (408.62) offers technical setup for mean-reversion bounce if exhaustion signals flush out weak hands.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme RSI overbought (98.24), stochastic bearish cross, inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels (353.1), zero fundamental catalysts, and price below both 50/200 EMAs create a perfect storm of exhaustion + macro headwinds that invalidates technical bullishness.

decision.entry_rationale: Do not enter. Extreme RSI overbought (98.24) with stochastic bearish cross signals imminent exhaustion despite bullish trend structure. Macro environment (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, earnings in 87 days) combined with zero fundamental catalysts and existing EPAM position creates unfavorable risk/reward.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis levels (353.1) and inverted yield curve indicate systemic market stress; pullback from overbought extremes could trigger 5-8% drawdown before any bounce materializes, invalidating mean-reversion thesis.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bearish bias; technical exhaustion, fundamental weakness, and macro headwinds converge
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding EPAM position with 32 other IT holdings (9% sector concentration); adding to existing concentration during crisis VIX and earnings proximity violates risk discipline.
